section.38: Chapters on the description of Paradise

38.name_native: Chapters on the description of Paradise

hadiths.text: Narrated 'Ikrimah bin Abi Jahl:"The day that I came to him, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Welcome to the riding emigrant.'" There are narrations on this topic from Buraidah, Ibn 'Abbas, and Abu Juhaifah
